decisions.A: Controlled compiler profiles verified only for tested feature subsets; stock remains UnknownProfile.
decisions.B: Physical emitters need geometry, visibility and independent observations; low RGB residual is insufficient.
decisions.C: NNLS/BVLS only for genuinely linear blocks; bounded geometry, discrete profile/count/type, explicit shadow topology.
decisions.D: Quality includes source correctness, heldout prediction, coverage/observability, attribution and uncertainty.

assumptions: Raw RGB8, source-relative, calibrated scene and physically authored intensities stay distinct.
Grid ambient/directed are distinct observation operators, not universal indirect/direct components.
Source-linked passive GI must not absorb wrong-direct-profile discrepancy.
Region IDs are optional; unavailable geometry is never clear.
No inverse solver, runtime light or consumer dependency is added.
